model.name: taskStatus.deriveAndAssert
model.description: R-C5: statusChecklist = SOURCE (richer, sub-steps); status = DERIVED via deriveStatusEnum = highest checked top-level box (Planned<In Progress<QA Review<Done) so the two CANNOT disagree by construction (DRY: derive the poorer from the richer). NO auto-override of the ~69 EXISTING disagreements (that would FLIP displayed Done-ness = status-invention) — instead the FAIL-LOUD assertStatusConsistent detector LISTS every offender, prioritizing the DANGEROUS status=Done + Done-box-UNCHECKED FALSE-DONE subset (+ the 1 malformed checklist). Resolution flows checklist->status, never reverse; owner-resolved at task level = the planner honest-Done worklist. Architect design design-rc5-dual-status-reconcile.md.
model.helperNote: deriveStatusEnum (Method f0f9eaa4) is the pure derive fn assertStatusConsistent calls; both live on Class TaskStatus. The by-construction 'status derives from checklist' AND the fail-loud detector are ONE R-C5 behavior (deriveAndAssert). BITE Test targets assertStatusConsistent.
